Parallel Systems is seeking a Software Engineer II to help build the train control software that lets our autonomous rail vehicles operate safely on the rail network. Prior rail experience is not required; curiosity and a willingness to learn a deep domain are.
Responsibilities:
Implement and extend backend features for critical train control applications, adding support for new train control concepts with guidance from senior engineers.
Develop and maintain system-level software written primarily in Rust.
Improve the reliability and correctness of existing code by finding and fixing edge cases in train control logic.
Write and test code that meets our safety, security, and compliance standards.
Debug and diagnose issues in simulation and on real hardware, escalating complex problems when needed.
Participate in code reviews and technical discussions and help write technical specs for the features you build.
What Success Looks Like:
After 30 days: You understand the core concepts behind train control (movement authorities, bulletins, switches, and signals) and how they're implemented technically in our system through motion rules and Parallel blocks. You've added support for one or two missing edge cases in train control.

After 90 days: You've added support for several new train control features and have a solid understanding of the gap between what's required to support PTC and what exists in our system today.

#TeamNextdoor
Nextdoor (NYSE: NXDR) is the essential neighborhood network. Neighbors, public agencies, and businesses use Nextdoor to connect around local information that matters in more than 350,000 neighborhoods across 11 countries. Nextdoor builds innovative technology to foster local community, share important news, and create neighborhood connections at scale. Download the app and join the neighborhood at nextdoor.com .
Meet Your Future Neighbors
In conjunction with product management and design, the engineering team at Nextdoor is responsible for bringing to life the experiences that empower neighbors to build stronger communities and transform how people connect and engage with their local area. Working in small cross-functional teams, you’ll work in an agile environment that values code quality, learning quickly, and personal growth through collaboration and challenge.
You will collaborate with front end, back end, data science, infrastructure, and machine learning engineers to collectively improve the state of engineering at Nextdoor. All engineers are invited to join co-ops to facilitate continuous modernization and knowledge sharing.
At Nextdoor, we operate in an AI-first environment and expect every team member to actively use AI tools as part of their workflow. We aren't looking for prompt engineers; we’re looking for people who use tools like Claude, Gemini, ChatGPT, and Glean to challenge their own thinking and take full ownership of AI-assisted outputs.
We also offer a warm and inclusive work environment that embraces a hybrid employment model, blending an in office presence and work from home experience for our valued employees. The hiring team will go over these expectations with you if you are being considered for a role near one of our offices in San Francisco, Los Angeles, Chicago, Dallas, New York, and London.
The Impact You’ll Make
As a Fullstack Engineer on Nextdoor’s Local Conversations team, you’ll join the Rewards & Incentives pod and help build product experiences that encourage meaningful participation in neighborhood communities. You’ll work across the frontend and backend, with a strong focus on building high-quality web experiences using React and Python/Django.
You’ll contribute to two evolving product areas to start. This is a highly hands-on engineering role. You’ll contribute to entity-relationship modeling, solution architecture, implementation, testing, and iteration, while partnering with product, design, and engineering teammates.
You’ll also participate in team operating practices, including a gradual on-call shadow rotation after onboarding and ramp-up. The team will review role-specific expectations with candidates during the hiring process.
What You’ll Bring to The Team
Experience building and shipping software in a production environment
Strong frontend fundamentals and experience with modern JavaScript and React. This is an important part of the role
Experience with a server-side web application language; Python/Django experience is strongly preferred
Familiarity with SQL and developing across frontend and backend systems
Ability to break down product requirements, collaborate on technical approaches, and implement maintainable solutions
Strong collaboration and communication skills, both verbal and written
Ability to be flexible and adaptable in a dynamic environment
Interest in contributing ideas and product perspective, not just executing predefined tasks
2+ years of software development experience and a demonstrated ability to own projects with increasing independence. Level will be determined based on experience and demonstrated proficiency
Experience with Storybook or other component-driven development practices is a plus
Eagerness to explore and apply AI tools and emerging technologies to reimagine how work gets done
Willingness to participate in in-person Nextdoor events such as trainings, off-sites, volunteer days, and team building exercises, as applicable to your location
Interest in building relationships with teammates and contributing to Nextdoor’s culture
Rewards
Compensation, benefits, perks, and recognition programs at Nextdoor come together to create our total rewards package. Compensation will vary depending on your relevant skills, experience, and qualifications.
The starting salary for this role is expected to range from $135,000- $200,000 on an annualized basis, or potentially greater in the event that your level of proficiency exceeds the level expected for the role. The salary range will be determined by the candidate’s geographic location.
We expect to award a meaningful equity grant for this role. With quarterly vesting, your first vest date will take place within 3 months of your start date.
When it comes to benefits, we have you covered! Nextdoor employees can choose between a variety of health plans, including a 100% covered employee-only plan option, and we also provide a OneMedical membership for concierge care.
At Nextdoor, we empower our employees to build stronger local communities. To create a platform where all feel welcome, we want our workforce to reflect the diversity of the neighbors we serve. We encourage everyone interested in our mission to apply. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, gender, religion, sexual orientation, age, or any other trait that unfairly targets a group of people. In accordance with the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, we always consider qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.
For information about our collection and use of applicants’ personal information, please see Nextdoor's Personnel Privacy Notice, found here .

About Upsun (formerly Platform.sh)
Upsun is the cloud application platform humans and robots love. It is built for today’s hybrid teams, where AI agents write and test code and humans focus on solving the problems that really matter. Developers, DevOps engineers, and platform teams use Upsun to build, ship, and scale confidently without wrestling with backend infrastructure. We give you your time back. You get:
Predictable performance, even at scale
Secure, compliant environments by default
Real-time observability and profiling built in
Cloning, configuration, and provisioning in seconds
AI-ready features that plug directly into your stack
The name says it all. "Up" means uptime, reliability, and acceleration. "Sun" reflects our follow-the-sun-support, a 24x7, globally distributed support team keeping the lights on while you rest. Our core belief is that software should power brighter solutions and greater innovation.
Upsunners are a remote, global workforce, and we thrive in a multicultural team. We are committed to open source and an open, welcoming environment. Our team spans the globe and the experience spectrum.
What's our commonality, our cultural fabric? A curious spirit and a thirst for knowledge; an eagerness for innovative ideas and cultures. We believe we can build anything together in an environment that frees you to do your best work.
Our values:
🌿 We make a positive impact.
✨ We aim for the stars.
💚 We care for each other.
Impact of a Software Engineer
As a Software Engineer at Upsun, you will build and maintain the backend services behind our customers' billing. Billing is your main focus: invoices, taxes, usage reporting, and the integrations that connect our platform to the commercial systems behind it. These systems handle tens of millions in revenue each year across multiple products, entities, and currencies. Accuracy matters, and your work reaches customers directly.
You will own components in this space and act as a key link between engineering, Finance, and Product. Every new offering Upsun launches needs a billing component, and you will help build it. Over time, you will become a long-term owner of the systems you build. You may also contribute to adjacent services such as project provisioning and account management.
What to expect
Build billing integrations: Develop and maintain backend services and API integrations in Go that connect our platform to external billing systems.
Ship usage-based billing features: Build features such as usage tracking, estimates, usage alerts, and invoicing. Work with other engineering teams to understand how new features are measured and charged.
Complete billing migrations: Help finish moving billing to external systems while keeping data accurate and customers unaffected.
Troubleshoot and fix issues: Investigate and resolve billing issues raised by Support and Finance, from incorrect usage data to failed integrations.
Protect customers and data: Contribute to anti-abuse measures and keep security in mind when working with sensitive customer and payment data.
Work across teams: Partner with Finance, Product, and Support, and communicate clearly and asynchronously with a team spread across Europe, North America, and India.
Build with good practice: Write tested, well-documented code, take part in pair programming and code review, and use AI-assisted tools thoughtfully in your workflow.
What you bring
Go development experience: 3+ years of professional backend development in Go.
Relational databases: Hands-on experience working with relational databases such as PostgreSQL or MySQL/MariaDB.
Third-party API integration: Experience integrating with external REST APIs, including handling errors, retries, and rate limits.
Care for accuracy: Attention to detail in systems where a mistake can reach a customer's invoice, and an interest in concepts like idempotency and consistency in distributed systems.
Testing and reliability: A habit of writing unit and integration tests, including for failure paths, and thinking about how your code behaves in production.
Security awareness: An understanding of common security vulnerabilities and how to avoid them in backend services.
Interest in billing: You enjoy working on billing and financial systems and want to make them your focus.
Clear async communication: You write clearly and collaborate well across teams and time zones.
Where we hire
At Upsun, remote work isn't just a trend - it's our foundation. The freedom of remote work with the support of a diverse, global team has been our successful model for over a decade. Our culture celebrates flexibility and collaboration, and while we have team members in over 30 countries around the globe, we are currently focused on hiring for this role in Canada, France, Germany, Spain, and the United Kingdom . Although we’re unable to provide visa sponsorship at this time, we welcome applications from all qualified candidates who are legally authorized to work in these countries.
How we hire
We know that a great hire won’t meet every requirement that we’ve outlined. If you can see yourself elevating the team, we want to hear your story. Few of us would be here had we not taken a chance.
You can expect 3 interviews on Google Meet to follow the order below. Should you successfully move through the entire process you will have the opportunity to meet with a variety of Upsunners. Our goal is to ensure you can make the most informed decision on whether this role, and our culture aligns with what you’re looking for in your future working environment.
45 Minutes with Talent Acquisition
60 Minutes with Hiring Manager
60 Minutes with Team (Pair Programming Session in CoderPad)
All roles require background checks.
What we offer
💡 A product you can believe in - Join us in transforming how businesses build and manage web applications, driven making a positive impact as a proud B Corp .
🏆 An Award-Winning Workplace - We’ve been recognized by Forbes’ Top 30 Companies for Remote Jobs and France’s Best Workplaces for Women.
🗣️ A culture that values your voice - Join a flexible, open, and inclusive work environment where your voice is encouraged, and your ideas shape our growth and evolution.
🌎 A global team - Collaborate with colleagues from diverse backgrounds across the world, embracing different perspectives

🏝 Flexible PTO

🧠 Professional development budget

💆‍♀️ Wellness budget
🧳 Annual team gatherings
🛜 Internet reimbursement

✈️ Remote work travel program

We embrace and value different perspectives, backgrounds, and experiences, because they make us stronger as a team.
